reasons: Only genuinely new fact is the confirmed victim count (3,834,294, Indiana AG filing); every other datum (breach window 04-13/04-19, exposed fields, device segregation, delisting-suggests-ransom) is already in the original 2026-07-03 entry, which already framed ~9M as the actor's CLAIM.
Fails PD-11 actionability: no patch/hunt/block/detect/escalation changes for a Swiss/EU SOC.

US medtech corporate-IT breach, no CH/EU direct nexus; does not independently clear the stricter PD-11 breach inclusion gate (no global significance, no new/evolved TTP, no new same-actor read, no imminent shared threat).

The 'leak-site claims inflate scope' observation is new relative to the original entry (which carried the distinct delisting-does-not-equal-destruction lesson), but standing alone it fails the actionability + out-of-nexus breach gate; the original already framed ~9M as the actor's CLAIM, so no false figure stands uncorrected.

Recency (PD-7): the new figure was first reported by SecurityWeek 2026-07-03 (~75h, at/just outside the 72h developing floor); the sole in-window source (Security Affairs 2026-07-05) is a re-report of the same figure with no fresh delta.
